csv-table.name: CSV Table
csv-table.description: Paste or drop a CSV and read it as a clean table — quotes, commas, and newlines handled properly.

tsv-table.name: TSV Table
tsv-table.description: Paste or drop tab-separated data and read it as a clean table.

html-preview.name: HTML Preview
html-preview.description: Render HTML in a sandboxed frame — scripts blocked unless you allow them.

office-to-pdf.name: Office to PDF
office-to-pdf.description: Convert Word, Excel, or PowerPoint files to PDF — processed privately on your own Omnio, never a third-party service.

ui.privacy: Parsed in your browser — the data never leaves your device.
ui.htmlAllowScripts: Allow scripts to run in the preview
ui.o2pNote: Upload a document and Omnio converts it to PDF on your own server, then hands the result back. Your file never leaves your Omnio.
